claim_scope: One fixed auxiliary-overhead experiment on three frozen v2 families (anchor, injected, indirection): B analogue / C control / J Jev with and without a real auxiliary LLM note before every action decision. Descriptive only; not an ALFWorld/AndroidWorld reproduction and not an estimate of the paper's effect sizes.
classification_rule: frozen audit classify_transfer: NO_LOCAL_SAVING if decision delta >= 0; else OVERHEAD_ABSORPTION if task delta >= 0; else DELIVERY_PARADOX if delivered delta >= 0; else TRANSFERRED. Deltas are the new arm relative to the base arm (negative = saving).
interpretation_guards: A decision-level advantage is not an agent advantage unless delivered-success metrics agree.
Both compared cells near 0% or 100% means non-discriminating, not support.
Speed/cost compare different providers (reference values); Jev cost = tokens x assumed price.
The auxiliary stage is a T3A-style analogue, not the paper's; B is an analogue, not the paper's B.
